title: What Rajasthan get by splitting the Sam Curran role
dek: Rajasthan bring in Mohammed Shami and M. Siddharth while Sam Curran moves to Lucknow. The trade opens two bowling choices and a question lower down the order.
excerpt: Rajasthan bring in Mohammed Shami and M. Siddharth while Sam Curran moves to Lucknow. The trade opens two bowling choices and a question lower down the order.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: The IPL confirmed Shami and Siddharth to RR and Curran to LSG. {{src:announcement}}
RR can test the batting cost of choosing two specialist bowlers.

sections.heading: One move, two selection decisions
body: Rajasthan can now write separate names beside new-ball pace and left-arm spin. Shami and Siddharth arrive from Lucknow, with Curran going the other way. {{src:announcement}}
The interesting space on the team sheet is the batting position Curran might have occupied.

sections.heading: Read the transfer in both directions
body: The IPL advisory confirms the three moves. {{src:announcement}}
A squad planner counting open roles should place the arrivals in Rajasthan immediately. Treating them as auction targets would count the same cover twice.

sections.heading: Start with the new ball
body: One possible plan gives Shami the new ball and keeps a spinner available if a right-handed pair settles.
Write the final four overs down as well. A powerplay plan that exhausts the best seam options early hands an awkward job to the last bowler.

sections.heading: The price of a specialist
body: Playing two specialists takes two places. The choice becomes sharper on a surface where a long batting order could matter more than an extra spin option.
Rajasthan can test that trade-off by picking a chase XI and a defending XI on the same pitch. The last player omitted is the one worth discussing.

sections.heading: An auction question worth pricing
body: Before bidding for another bowler, pencil in who walks out after the sixth wicket.
If the same batter has to finish a chase and cover an injury higher up, additional batting cover deserves a price on the auction sheet.
